description:
You are deploying an update for an IoT data collector written in Python. In the project directory /home/user/iot-data-collector, you maintain a VERSION file that contains the semantic version of the package, for example 1.2.3. There is also a CHANGELOG.md file that records release notes in a specific format. A new minor feature was added, so increment the project's version (the "minor" version) according to semantic versioning. Update VERSION with the new version. After bumping the version, add a new entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md following this format exactly (note the blank line between entries): 
## [NEW_VERSION] - YYYY-MM-DD

- Added new data aggregation endpoint for edge nodes.
Replace [NEW_VERSION] with the correct new version (e.g. 1.3.0), and YYYY-MM-DD with today's date in ISO-8601 format. Keep existing changelog entries below and separated by a single blank line. Do not change or remove older entries. When finished, display the first 7 lines of CHANGELOG.md in the terminal so the release log can be reviewed.
